Done. I built, verified, and documented a complete solution for the problem class.

## Deliverables

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `~/SOLUTION.md` | Self-contained write-up: diagnosis, model, DP, full code, verification |
| `~/checkpoint_dp.py` | Reference implementation (`optimal_checkpointing`, `InfeasibleError`, `brute_force`) |
| `~/verify_checkpoint.py` | Executable verification suite |
| `~/test_checkpoint_dp.py` | Differential + schedule validator |

## Root cause

The failure mode is a **memory-accounting mistake** plus a model gap:

- Peak live bytes at segment `(p,q]` is
  `Σ A[c] over stored checkpoints c ≤ p` **+** `Σ A[p+1..q-1]`.
  Using `Σ A[0..p]` (all activations to the left) falsely reports infeasibility; forgetting the recompute buffer returns schedules that exceed `M`.
- A count-only DP ignores activation bytes and breaks under heterogeneous `a_i`.
- Skewed instances and segments whose buffer alone exceeds `M` require **finer (deeper) subdivision**, not one fixed `√n` spacing.
- Infeasible instances must raise, not fall back to an approximate schedule.

## Algorithm

Exact Pareto DP over `(position p, checkpoints left c)` → frontier of
`prefix_bytes → (cost, backpointer)`. Because past peak never restricts the future, states dominated in `(prefix, cost)` are safely pruned. Every transition enforces `prefix + buffer ≤ M`; terminals exceeding no terminal produce `InfeasibleError`. A fast path handles `M ≥ total bytes` in `O(n log n)`.

## Verification (all passing)

- **6 700 randomized cases (n ≤ 11)** compared against exhaustive enumeration; DP cost == optimal, every returned schedule re-validated from the definition
- **√n uniform case**: with `M = 2√n+2`, gets `peak = 2√n+2`, `#checkpoints ≈ √n`, `cost ≈ n−√n` (n=1024 → 33 checkpoints, peak 66, cost 990)
- **Infeasible case**: `a=[100,…]`, `M=60` raises `InfeasibleError`
- **Heterogeneous instance**: `checkpoints=[0,2,4,6]`, peak 90 ≤ 140, cost 11
- The code block embedded in `SOLUTION.md` was extracted and independently re-tested (3 000 more cases)

Run it with:
```bash
cd ~ && python3 verify_checkpoint.py
```
